trades.rationale: RWJ shows negative earnings growth (-5.2%) and a negative implied 12m return (-1.47%), the weakest forward setup in the book; funding a move into SMH which has 156% earnings growth and 31.08% implied return (32.5pp spread) clears the hurdle by a wide margin.
SMH offers 31.08% implied 12m return backed by 156% earnings growth and forward P/E of just 18.82 vs trailing 41.79 -- strong multiple compression on accelerating earnings.

RZV's implied 12.48%-14.48% return is propped up despite -63.6% earnings growth, a fundamentally weak small-cap value sleeve; SOXX offers 29.35% implied return with 155% earnings growth, a 14.87pp spread clearing the hurdle.
SOXX's forward P/E of 23.38 on 155% earnings growth and 53% six-month momentum represents a much stronger forward-return profile than RZV's negative-earnings small-cap value exposure.
